items.quote: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh
items.claim: Abraham commanded his eldest servant to place his hand under his thigh as a gesture of oath-taking

items.quote: that ruled over all that he had
items.claim: Abraham's eldest servant had authority over all of Abraham's possessions

items.quote: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites
items.claim: Abraham commanded his servant to swear an oath not to take a wife for Isaac from among the Canaanites

items.quote: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac
items.claim: Abraham commanded his servant to travel to Abraham's country and kinfolk to take a wife for Isaac
